notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
description:
Deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.
Frilled Deathspitter and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Frilled Deathspitter trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Frilled Deathspitter instead due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.
